items.claim: Nasrat Haqparast has accumulated so much damage throughout his career that his chin is completely gone.
items.quote: Hacobrast the cumulative da- cumulative damage throughout his career is just so much... I think the Hacobrast chin's kind of go- I think it's gone now.

items.claim: Chris Padilla hits very hard for his size.
items.quote: Padeia does hit hard for his size.

items.claim: Shamil Gaziev took a significant amount of damage and was knocked out just three months ago against Branko Pericic.
items.quote: Gaziev just got knocked out three months ago. I hate that. The brain needs time to heal... In the span of 8 minutes, Branko Pericic lands 90 significant strikes against Gaziev.

items.claim: Shamil Gaziev is significantly better with his wrestling than Kennedy Nzechukwu.
items.quote: if the fight does end up on the mat, Gaziev is significantly better with his wrestling than Insedjiku is.

items.claim: Lerone Murphy has won six consecutive fights by knockout across LFA, Contender Series, and the UFC.
items.quote: now it's six consecutive knockouts in a row for Douglas.

items.claim: Lerone Murphy has been submitted twice in his professional career.
items.quote: Leri on Douglas has been subbed twice in his career. Those come to Shepe Mariscal in 2018 and then in XFC in 2014.

items.claim: Jamall Emmers relies on a persistent wrestling attack, landing seven takedowns in his recent win over Haider Amil.
items.quote: very, you know, persistent wrestling attack, let's say, from Jamall Emmers. Lands seven takedowns on eight attempts over eight minutes of control time
